name: Zucchini
description: Known as courgette in many kitchens. This tender summer squash works in everything from fritters to quick breads.

storage.label: Whole
storage.preparation: Keep whole until ready to use.
storage.advice: Store in the crisper and wash before cutting.
storage.caution: Buy only what you can use within a few days.

buying: Smaller tender squash suit slicing and quick cooking.
freshness: Discard rotten produce. Use package instructions for pre-cut zucchini.
leftovers: Grate into fritters or a quick bread.

freezing.instructions: Wash and cut into ½-inch slices. Water-blanch for 3 minutes, cool promptly, drain, package, and freeze.
freezing.quality: The texture softens; use in cooked meals.
